                <article class="pgcomponent" data-item-id="3248008" data-display-style="normal">
            <div class="pgpost">
  <p>Optimizely’s certification exams are developed following industry-accepted standards to ensure validity and reliability. Our certification exams assess knowledge and skill requirements that are considered relevant to professional job roles.</p>

<p>Being certified by Optimizely helps you stay up to date on relevant skills needed to be considered successful in your role using our products. Additionally, certification through Optimizely helps you validate your professional experience—bolstering career advancement and recognition in your field.</p>

<p><strong>When you are ready to take your exam</strong></p>

<p>After you have gained experience and prepared for your exam, you will have 14 days to complete it once purchased. With each attempt, you will have 60 minutes to complete 50 multiple choice questions. Failure to complete all questions on time will result in a failed assessment. Upon failing, you are required to wait 24 hours before you can retake an assessment. Failure to pass this assessment within 14 days will require you to purchase a new exam attempt.</p>

<p><strong>Once you pass your exam</strong></p>

<p>You will receive an email notification for a Credly badge. You will retain your certified status for 24 months. If you do not see an email from Credly in your inbox, please check your other, junk, and spam folders. After 24 months, you will need to re-certify by taking the latest exam version.</p>

<h2 id="prepare-for-exams-0">Prepare for exams</h2>

<ul>
<li>  Complete the <a href="https://academy.optimizely.com/student/catalog/list?category_ids=41482-elearning" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">eLearning</a> available for your product and role</li>
<li>  Look closely at the appropriate exam guides and relevant reference materials that can be found on the individual exam pages listed below.</li>
</ul>

</div>

### Outline

*   [Purchase exams](/student/page/2252003-about-certification-exams#purchase-exams-1)

Optimizely’s certification exams are developed following industry-accepted standards to ensure validity and reliability. Our certification exams assess knowledge and skill requirements that are considered relevant to professional job roles.

Being certified by Optimizely helps you stay up to date on relevant skills needed to be considered successful in your role using our products. Additionally, certification through Optimizely helps you validate your professional experience—bolstering career advancement and recognition in your field.

**When you are ready to take your exam**

After you have gained experience and prepared for your exam, you will have 14 days to complete it once purchased. With each attempt, you will have 60 minutes to complete 50 multiple choice questions. Failure to complete all questions on time will result in a failed assessment. Upon failing, you are required to wait 24 hours before you can retake an assessment. Failure to pass this assessment within 14 days will require you to purchase a new exam attempt.

**Once you pass your exam**

You will receive an email notification for a Credly badge. You will retain your certified status for 24 months. If you do not see an email from Credly in your inbox, please check your other, junk, and spam folders. After 24 months, you will need to re-certify by taking the latest exam version.

## Prepare for exams

*   Complete the [eLearning](https://academy.optimizely.com/student/catalog/list?category_ids=41482-elearning) available for your product and role
*   Look closely at the appropriate exam guides and relevant reference materials that can be found on the individual exam pages listed below.
